name: Rufus
description: Rufus's Windows updater fetches a platform-specific .ver file and companion .sig, rejects an invalid RSA signature, and validates the retrieved executable with Windows trust checks, including an allowed signer and a newer signature timestamp. The reviewed source covers the interactive updater path; it does not establish a universal no-execution guarantee for every retrieved content type.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; this review is limited to the Windows updater source and does not inspect every downloaded auxiliary file.
